proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_signal_type (directional-long family: UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY) = UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY (100% directional-long) (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_signal_type (directional-long family: UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY) = UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY (100% directional-long); recommended action: Pause new entries in signal_type ∈ {UP_TRI, BULL_PROXY} until at least one non-directional-long position (DOWN_TRI or hedge) is added, OR hedge the book with an index short (e.g., NIFTY futures short sized to ~30-40% of gross long exposure) to neutralize directional-long monoculture until Bull×UP_TRI cohort matures beyond Candidate tier.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime flips from the current mixed Choppy/Bull posture into a Bear/sharp-correction regime, 100% of the book takes the drawdown simultaneously with no offsetting shorts and no cohort-validated edge to justify holding through — worst-case correlated stop-out across all 11 positions on the same day.

evidence: Top cell UP_TRI×Bull×Bank at 18.18% (2/11) sits just below the 0.20 hard threshold
Regime mix: Choppy 63.6% / Bull 36.4% — no single-regime trigger, but Bull cell is concentrated
Matched cohort Bull×UP_TRI is Candidate-tier (n=145) — edge not validated
Extends 20+ consecutive days of directional-long monoculture warn streak on unvalidated cohorts
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new entries in signal_type ∈ {UP_TRI, BULL_PROXY} until at least one non-directional-long position (DOWN_TRI or hedge) is added, OR hedge the book with an index short (e.g., NIFTY futures short sized to ~30-40% of gross long exposure) to neutralize directional-long monoculture until Bull×UP_TRI cohort matures beyond Candidate tier.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If regime flips from the current mixed Choppy/Bull posture into a Bear/sharp-correction regime, 100% of the book takes the drawdown simultaneously with no offsetting shorts and no cohort-validated edge to justify holding through — worst-case correlated stop-out across all 11 positions on the same day.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: No single hard threshold is breached individually — regime concentration at 63.64% Choppy sits below 0.80, top cell UP_TRI×Bull×Bank at 18.18% is below 0.20, and UP_TRI at 8/11 = 72.7% is below 0.85. However, combining UP_TRI (8) with BULL_PROXY (3) yields 11/11 = 100% directional-long exposure — a full monoculture — and the matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort remains Candidate-tier (n=145), unvalidated edge. This extends a multi-week warn streak of directional-long exposure without cohort validation.

proposals.title: Regime shift: Bull → Choppy

claim.expected_effect: A fourth consecutive Choppy day tomorrow would flip the 7d distribution to Choppy majority and confirm the transition; a return to Bull tomorrow would reclassify these three days as a deeper wobble within a still-intact Bull regime.

evidence: Third consecutive Choppy day (days_in_current_regime=3) breaks the isolated single-day spike pattern flagged 08-23 and 08-24
Recent 7d distribution 4 Bull / 3 Choppy has tightened dramatically from prior 7d 5 Bull / 2 Choppy — Bull majority eroding to near-parity
Weekly slope decelerated from +0.008266 to +0.00356 (>50% reduction) though still positive, and avg_ret20 fell to 1.52
Price remains above EMA50 but momentum losing conviction, consistent with regime transition from trending to ranging
risks: Detection may be one-week wobble misclassified as transition
Trader manual confirmation required; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational alert; no system mutation. Auto-suppresses on next run if regime stabilizes.
